# PromptZone

> > PromptZone is a leading AI community platform for prompt engineers and AI enthusiasts to share knowledge, discover tools, and discuss cutting-edge developments in generative AI.

PromptZone is a Forem-based open-source community built for prompt engineering, AI tools exploration, and collaborative learning. The platform aggregates curated AI research, tutorials, and discussions across major LLM platforms including ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Mistral, while fostering conversations on AI ethics, policy, and real-world applications.

## Key Topics

- Prompt Engineering
- Generative AI
- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- ChatGPT & GPT Models
- Google Gemini
- Claude
- AI Tools & Platforms
- Image Generation
- Video Generation
- Machine Learning
- AI Ethics
- AI News & Policy
- Military AI
- Job Impact of AI
- AI Community

## Core Platform

- [PromptZone Homepage](https://www.promptzone.com): Premier AI community for prompt engineers and enthusiasts
- [Welcome & Authentication](https://www.promptzone.com/enter): Login and signup page with social authentication options
- [About PromptZone](https://www.promptzone.com/about-us): Mission, vision, and Forem-based open-source platform overview
- [Community Welcome](https://www.promptzone.com/t/welcome): Community introduction to tools, news, and tutorials

## Prompt Engineering & Resources

- [Prompt Cheat Sheet](https://www.promptzone.com/prompts): Templates and cheat sheets for GPT, Claude, Gemini, and Mistral
- [AI Learning Roadmap](https://www.promptzone.com/ai-resources): Self-study roadmap with free and paid ML/AI resources from beginner to advanced
- [Prompt Engineering Discussions](https://www.promptzone.com/t/prompt): Tutorials and discussions on prompt engineering, image generation, and code generation
- [Tutorial Hub](https://www.promptzone.com/t/tutorial): Tutorials on AI tools, music generation, video creation, and prompt techniques

## AI Models & Tools

- [ChatGPT Discussions](https://www.promptzone.com/t/chatgpt): ChatGPT topic discussions including GPT-5.4, image generation, and video creation
- [Google Gemini Discussions](https://www.promptzone.com/t/gemini): Gemini topic covering video creation, photo generation, art prompts, and code generation
- [Large Language Models (LLMs)](https://www.promptzone.com/t/llm): LLM discussions on local AI, agents, reasoning, and tools like LlamaIndex
- [Community Tags Directory](https://www.promptzone.com/tags): Directory of community tags for AI tools, ChatGPT, Gemini, Sora, and more

## News & Research

- [AI News Feed](https://www.promptzone.com/t/news): AI news covering military AI, ethics, generative AI, and job market impact
- [AI Topic Feed](https://www.promptzone.com/t/ai): AI discussions including ethics, policy, jobs, and institutional developments with Pentagon and Palantir
- [Curated AI Research Papers](https://www.promptzone.com/papers): Curated AI research papers covering NLP, computer vision, and multimodal learning
